Stephanie — quick answers below, happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through details.

EU-only processing:
- Hosted: we support region pinning for inference and associated ephemeral logs. Persistent storage for customer artifacts (model snapshots, fine-tune artifacts) can be constrained to EU regions. We currently do not replicate raw telemetry outside EU unless customer opts in; aggregate metrics may flow to US analytics but can be disabled per-customer (we can include that in the DPA).
- Dedicated/Private: full EU-only deployment is supported (control plane can be customer-managed in Private install).

Private connectivity:
- Supported connection types in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1: VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Endpoint, GCP Private Service Connect (availability dependent on deployment model). Provisioning lead time: 2–4 weeks for Dedicated pools; 1–2 weeks for Hosted PrivateConnect depending on partner setup.

SCCs/DPA:
- We use EU SCCs (2021 standard) and will include EU-residency clause. Ben, let's prepare a redline that allows for exception for lawful requests from authorities and a clear data deletion/return timeframe.

Attachments/evidence: I'll attach the redacted SOC 2 and network diagram to the Hub Drive and drop answers into their SIG sheet. Also recommend adding the DPIA note — for regulated health data we'll require a DPIA sign-off and may need tighter contract terms (HIPAA carve-outs if PHI is expected).
